dev/bundle_nasa_cfd_003.acceptance_criteria: Model inputs match experimental conditions; boundary condition matching verified.

dev/bundle_nasa_cfd_005.acceptance_criteria: Traceable input data sources with known quality (ISO 17025 certificates).

dev/bundle_nasa_cfd_005.acceptance_criteria: Evidence of independent technical review (peer review, review board findings).

dev/bundle_nasa_cfd_005.acceptance_criteria: Systematic development processes (configuration management, requirements traceability).

dev/bundle_nasa_cfd_005.acceptance_criteria: Uncertainty quantification on model outputs using probabilistic methods, sensitivity analysis, or expanded uncertainty.
dev/bundle_nasa_cfd_005.rationale: Expanded uncertainty (k=2) of ±3.8 m (±2.7%) calculated for BEP head. Sensitivity analysis performed for roughness, turbulence, clearance, and mixing plane. Uncertainty budget accounts for discretization, input parameters, and model form.

dev/bundle_nasa_cfd_005.acceptance_criteria: Results insensitive to reasonable perturbations; off-nominal condition testing.
dev/bundle_nasa_cfd_005.rationale: Sensitivity study showed head variation <0.4 m for inlet turbulence (within tolerance). Head variation -1.8 m for significant roughness increase (-1.2% efficiency). Model is robust for the "hydraulically smooth" specification but sensitive to roughness deviations.

dev/bundle_nasa_cfd_005.acceptance_criteria: Evidence that the model or similar models have been used successfully before.
dev/bundle_nasa_cfd_005.rationale: Internal benchmarking data (INT-TURB-2021-04) shows SST k-ω performed within 2.1% on three similar impellers. However, no specific flight heritage or legacy track record for this specific pump class or multi-stage configuration is documented.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.acceptance_criteria: Commercial solver certification and internal regression testing
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.rationale: ANSYS Fluent certified; internal verification exercises performed; configuration management in place.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.acceptance_criteria: Code reproduces analytical/exact solutions within specified error bounds
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.rationale: Graetz problem error <0.3%, Fin array error <0.8%, DNS comparison error <4%.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.acceptance_criteria: GCI below 5% threshold across primary QoIs
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.rationale: GCI values of 1.8% to 4.2% achieved on fine grid; monotonic convergence observed; GCI methodology applied.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.acceptance_criteria: Residuals converged below 1e-5 with integral quantity convergence <0.1%
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.rationale: Residuals below 1e-5; integral QoIs stable over final 500 iterations.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.acceptance_criteria: Boundary conditions verified; mesh quality within thresholds; independent review completed.
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.rationale: Boundary conditions documented; mesh metrics (skewness, orthogonal quality) within thresholds; minor review findings resolved.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.acceptance_criteria: Justification for turbulence model and governing equations provided with known limitations identified.
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.rationale: Realizable k-ε used with limitations noted for ribs; SST k-ω sensitivity run performed (+7% Nusselt); Sutherland law used.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.acceptance_criteria: Material properties from tested database; boundary conditions derived from external solution.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.acceptance_criteria: Adequate number of measurement points with statistical characterization.
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.rationale: 847 locations for Rig 7B; 23 embedded thermocouples for HPT system level; production-representative samples.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.acceptance_criteria: Calibrated instruments; controlled environment; measurement uncertainty quantified.
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.rationale: IR calibration traceable to blackbody; ambient reflection corrected; instrument uncertainty ±2.5°C.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.acceptance_criteria: Model inputs match experimental conditions with uncertainty propagation
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.rationale: Rig 7B matches Re/Pr but not pressure/temperature; engine test temperature (1748K) vs Rig (980K); compressibility effects not captured in validation (L2).

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.acceptance_criteria: Quantitative metrics (error percentages, correlation) with uncertainty bands.
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.rationale: 5.3°C RMS error; 91% within ±8°C; ±15°C match for 83% of HPT locations.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.acceptance_criteria: QoIs directly measure safety/performance concern; measurable both computationally and experimentally.
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.factor_type: Relevance of the quantities of interest
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.rationale: Peak metal temperature and Nusselt number directly feed into life prediction; measurable via thermocouples and simulation.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.acceptance_criteria: Validation conditions match intended use envelope or justified extrapolation.
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.factor_type: Relevance of the validation activities to the COU
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.rationale: Validation covers Re up to 65k (COU climb ~72k); compressibility gap identified and bias corrected; conservatism margin applied.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.acceptance_criteria: Input data sources traceable to calibration/certification.
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.rationale: IR calibration record CAL-IR-2023-04 linked; Material database MPD-DS-R80-2019 referenced; inflow data from aero group (AER-HGP-2023-112).

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.acceptance_criteria: Independent technical review of modeling, setup, and interpretation.
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.rationale: External review by Dr. Vasquez; 3 minor findings resolved; review records TFS-REVIEW-2024-0047.
Git version control for scripts/mesh; SIMDB integrity verified; reproducibility confirmed for archived case.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.acceptance_criteria: Uncertainty quantified on model outputs via propagation methods.
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.rationale: PCE propagation of 6 inputs; combined peak T uncertainty ±22°C (95%); sensitivity indices calculated.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.acceptance_criteria: Model insensitive to reasonable perturbations; sensitivity studies performed.
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.rationale: Sensitivity to showerhead flow (<4% change); Model form sensitivity (+7% with SST); Turbulence intensity sensitivity studied.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.acceptance_criteria: Prior successful application or flight heritage.
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_001.rationale: Lead analyst has 8 years CHT experience; similar turbulence closures used in previous validation campaigns; model track record in division.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.acceptance_criteria: Evidence simulation software has been tested and verified (e.g., regression testing, version control)

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.acceptance_criteria: Evidence the code correctly solves governing equations (e.g., analytical solutions, MMS, benchmark problems)

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.acceptance_criteria: Evidence spatial/temporal discretization is adequate (e.g., mesh convergence, GCI, Richardson extrapolation)

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.acceptance_criteria: Evidence iterative solver convergence is adequate (e.g., residual targets, convergence monitoring)
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.rationale: Residuals converged below 1e-5 (energy) and 1e-4 (momentum). Monitored variables (exit temp, heat flux) flattened to within 0.1% over 500 iterations.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.acceptance_criteria: Evidence the model was set up correctly (e.g., independent review, boundary condition verification)
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.rationale: Turbulence model (k-ω SST) and boundary conditions (film cooling, adiabatic wall) were selected based on literature and consistency with prior work, but lacked formal independent review. Mesh quality checks noted (y+ < 1 internal, 30-60 external).

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.acceptance_criteria: Evidence the mathematical model represents the physics (e.g., governing equations, constitutive model validation)
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.rationale: Model couples convection and conduction. Known limitations acknowledged: SST overpredicts heat transfer in strong curvature regions; rotating frame effects (Coriolis) not captured; TBC degradation not modeled.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.acceptance_criteria: Evidence input data is accurate and well-characterized (e.g., material properties, boundary conditions)
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.rationale: Material properties (Inconel-718) and boundary conditions (hot gas profile) are standard, but OEM rig data for the actual Rev-14c geometry has not materialized.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.acceptance_criteria: Evidence experimental test articles are adequate (e.g., number of specimens, statistical characterization)
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.rationale: Only one legacy test article (IC-04) available from Phase-I. Geometry is simplified rectangular channel, not representative of actual airfoil.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.acceptance_criteria: Evidence test conditions are well-controlled and measured (e.g., calibrated instruments, test standards)
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.rationale: No test data available for current Rev-14c blade geometry. Existing data from 2019 campaign had simplified coolant supply and geometry.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.acceptance_criteria: Evidence model inputs match experimental conditions (e.g., boundary condition matching, geometric fidelity)
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.rationale: Model validated against simplified geometry; actual airfoil geometry and corresponding boundary conditions are unvalidated. Flow separation effects in bends not fully explained.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.acceptance_criteria: Evidence comparing model predictions to experimental data (e.g., quantitative metrics, uncertainty bands)
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.rationale: Matched to within 6% on exit temperature and 12% on local heat flux at 5 stations. No quantitative uncertainty bands on predictions, only manual sensitivity table.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.acceptance_criteria: Evidence model outputs are relevant to the decision (e.g., QoI measures safety/performance)
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.factor_type: Relevance of the quantities of interest
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.rationale: Peak wall temperature is the key metric for low-cycle fatigue life estimation. Computationally and experimentally measurable.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.acceptance_criteria: Evidence validation conditions match the intended use (e.g., same operating conditions, geometry)
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.factor_type: Relevance of the validation activities to the COU
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.rationale: Validation is limited to take-off conditions on a simplified rectangular geometry. No data exists for actual airfoil geometry or cruise/ground idle conditions. Primary concern identified in memo.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.acceptance_criteria: Evidence that input data sources are traceable and of known quality
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.rationale: OEM STEP file exists but not formally archived. Legacy test data from Phase-I assumed but lacks formal ISO 17025 traceability records.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.acceptance_criteria: Evidence of independent technical review of the modeling and simulation effort
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.rationale: Review scheduled for 28 March. No independent technical review board meetings or peer review records mentioned prior to this memo.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.acceptance_criteria: Evidence of systematic development processes (e.g., configuration management, change control)
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.rationale: Files exist on shared drive but not formally archived. No formal configuration log or version control record for solver patches or UDFs.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.acceptance_criteria: Evidence of uncertainty quantification on model outputs
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.rationale: 22 K spread from parameter sweep is noted as "non-trivial" but explicitly NOT a full uncertainty estimate or confidence interval. No Monte Carlo or probabilistic methods performed.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.acceptance_criteria: Evidence model results are insensitive to reasonable perturbations
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.rationale: Sensitivity study performed on coolant temp, mass flow, and gas profile. Sensitivity to rotating frame effects and TBC is acknowledged as high (15% Nusselt impact, TBC not modeled), limiting robustness claim.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.acceptance_criteria: Evidence the model or similar models have been used successfully before
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_002.rationale: ANSYS Fluent has a long track record. Model has been used in prior blade cooling work, but specific validation against actual airfoil geometry is limited.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.acceptance_criteria: Commercial solver certification and regression testing
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.rationale: Regression testing performed against Fluent 2021 R2 baseline shows acceptable drift. No mention of commercial solver certification (ASD) or ISO processes. Independent review pending.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.acceptance_criteria: Method of Manufactured Solutions (MMS) or comparison to analytical solution for all physics
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.rationale: Interface verified against analytical Biot-number solution (error < 0.3%). RANS flow reproduced within 4.1% of correlation. No independent re-implementation of governing equations.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.acceptance_criteria: Grid Convergence Index (GCI) < 5% on the mesh selected for production runs
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.rationale: GCI calculated for Medium mesh is 3.2%. Executive summary incorrectly states fine mesh was used (GCI < 1%), but production runs used Medium mesh. This gap means the uncertainty associated with the Medium mesh (3.2%) was not propagated correctly in the final results summary.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.acceptance_criteria: Residual targets met for all coupled equations (momentum, energy, interface)
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.rationale: Energy residual plateaus at 2x10^-5, above the target of 10^-5. Solver log notes this, but the main deck does not explicitly call out this non-convergence as a gap affecting credibility, though independent checker flagged it.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.acceptance_criteria: Independent verification of setup, boundary conditions, and post-processing logic
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.rationale: Known JIRA issue (CHT-112) regarding post-processing script path causes silent data errors. No automated input checking. Setup review relied on analyst self-check and limited independent checks; concerns about contact resistance discrepancy and trailing-edge simplification not fully resolved.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.acceptance_criteria: Justification of turbulence model choice and physics approximations
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.rationale: Realizable k-ε selected despite known under-prediction in curved passages. Low-Mach approximation valid (Mach < 0.15). Contact resistance modeled as constant, not specific to the lot. SST k-ω sensitivity run planned but not completed.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.acceptance_criteria: Accurate, traceable input data for material properties and boundary conditions
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.rationale: Material properties interpolated from vendor database (no specific lot measurement). Contact resistance value from literature contradicts companion report measurement (±25% discrepancy). Turbulence intensity assumed without measurement. Combustor profile simplified (uniform circumferential distortion).

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.acceptance_criteria: Production-representative test articles with adequate measurement coverage
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.rationale: Dataset A is a scaled perspex model (3x), not production representative. Dataset B is a predecessor geometry with different pass-3 features (22 vs 18 holes). No statistical characterization of test article quality provided.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.acceptance_criteria: Calibrated instruments and controlled environment with documented measurement uncertainty
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.rationale: Experimental uncertainty for Dataset A assumed as ±5% without traceable calibration records. Dataset B data shows mean bias; TBC spallation in test article is plausible but unconfirmed. Combustor exit profile not fully characterized.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.acceptance_criteria: Model inputs match experimental conditions with uncertainty propagation
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.rationale: Geometric fidelity gaps (pedestals simplified, trailing edge slot simplified). Thermal BCs (combustor profile) and coolant BCs (turbulence intensity assumed) not directly equivalent to test conditions. Discrepancy between deck input and companion report input not resolved.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.acceptance_criteria: Quantitative metrics with uncertainty bands comparing model to experiment
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.rationale: Nu comparison within ±9%. T_peak comparison has mean bias of +12K but no formal uncertainty bands or correlation coefficients calculated for the validation judgment. Validation uncertainty not formally quantified.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.acceptance_criteria: QoI measures safety/performance concern measurable in both model and experiment
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.factor_type: Relevance of the quantities of interest
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.rationale: QoI is peak metal temperature, relevant to TBC sizing and creep life. Measurable computationally (medium mesh) and experimentally (thermocouples). Direct link to design decisions.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.acceptance_criteria: Validation conditions match the intended use envelope
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.factor_type: Relevance of the validation activities to the COU
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.rationale: Validation performed at nominal take-off. Not validated for part-power, hot-day, or degraded TBC conditions. Extrapolation requested by life prediction team. Independent checker noted this as a limitation.

Dataset A provided as PDF scan, raw data unavailable. Material properties from generic vendor database (MatWeb) snapshot. Contact resistance from literature, no lot-specific calibration. No formal data use agreements documented for external datasets.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.acceptance_criteria: Independent technical review of modeling effort
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.rationale: Independent checker (Dr. Lindqvist) performed review, identified gaps in mesh reporting, BC equivalency, and margin assessment. Review status "in progress" with open comments. No formal "Passed" or "Approved" sign-off yet.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.acceptance_criteria: Systematic development processes with configuration management
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.rationale: Files archived in Teamcenter and GitLab. Version control maintained for meshes and BC files. Gaps in traceability for MatWeb data and Stuttgart report. Executive summary not updated with Rev B changes.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.acceptance_criteria: Quantified uncertainty on model outputs (e.g., Monte Carlo, sensitivity analysis)
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.rationale: Sensitivity analysis performed (tornado plot). Combined RSS uncertainty calculated as ±33K. However, turbulence model uncertainty is estimated, not computed. Central value may be shifted by unquantified contact resistance error.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.acceptance_criteria: Prior successful applications or flight heritage
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_003.rationale: No evidence of prior use of this specific NGV-4 CHT model configuration or methodology on this geometry. Relies on validation against NGV-3 data and generic correlations.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.acceptance_criteria: Commercial solver certification (Fluent) + independent verification by regression suite
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.rationale: ANSYS Fluent 2023 R2 is release-verified; regression suite results reviewed. Independent analyst review of scripts and logic found no solver setup issues.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.acceptance_criteria: Method of Manufactured Solutions (MMS) or manufactured data showing correct order of convergence
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.rationale: Suite of manufactured-solution tests completed. Energy equation converges second-order (observed 1.94); fluid-solid coupling shows no order degradation.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.acceptance_criteria: Grid Convergence Index (GCI) < 1% or asymptotic range confirmed
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.rationale: Three-level mesh study (2.1M, 6.8M, 19.4M cells) yielded GCI of 0.9% on fine-to-medium interval. Production mesh (6.8M) justified as cost-performance optimum with GCI < 1%.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.acceptance_criteria: Residual reduction > 5 orders of magnitude; convergence monitoring variance < 0.2 K
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.rationale: Residuals dropped 5+ orders; mass imbalance < 0.003%. Area-averaged wall temperature variation < 0.2 K over final 2,000 iterations.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.acceptance_criteria: Mesh quality checks; boundary condition verification; mesh topology correct for intended physics
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.rationale: CAD matches CMM to ±0.05 mm. Minor issues (reference area, material table) identified by independent review and corrected. Solver setup correct per review. Residual uncertainties noted but not critical to logic.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.acceptance_criteria: Governing equations justified; turbulence model validated against known benchmarks
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.rationale: SST k-ω with low-Re correction used. Matches published performance on ribbed channels (Han benchmark). No in-house source modifications made.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.acceptance_criteria: Material properties from certified sources; boundary conditions measured or derived from validated models
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.rationale: Coolant properties curve-fit validated vs NIST (0.8% deviation). Alloy conductivity from supplier datasheet (Lot CM-4471) but no independent lot measurement performed (flagged as residual uncertainty). BCs from 1D network and external aerothermal RANS.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.acceptance_criteria: Adequate number of specimens/sensors; statistical characterization of measurement uncertainty
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.rationale: 42 thin-film RTD sensors embedded in scaled model. Unit-level validation of impingement physics provided.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.acceptance_criteria: Calibrated instruments; controlled environment; adherence to test standards
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.rationale: Test conducted at TTF. Matched Reynolds number (Re_D = 24,500). External BC fixed (decoupled from metal temp) — acknowledged as approximation but acceptable for design-point analysis.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.acceptance_criteria: Model inputs match experimental conditions; geometric fidelity ensured
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.rationale: CAD geometry matches investment cast. BCs (pressure, temperature profiles) derived from 1D network and external RANS. External BC decoupling introduces unquantified error at off-design but matched at design-point.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.acceptance_criteria: Quantitative error metrics; comparison points cover critical regions
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.rationale: Predicted vs measured wall temp agrees to ±8 K RMS. Literature benchmark matches Nusselt distribution within 12%/9%. Gaps: No full-blade validation; no engine conditions; no transient cycling data.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.acceptance_criteria: QoI (peak metal temp) measurable computationally and experimentally; directly measures safety/performance
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.factor_type: Relevance of the quantities of interest
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.rationale: Peak metal temp at stagnation point is the decision variable. Numerical uncertainty band (±11 K) and input uncertainty band (±34 K) derived and applied.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.acceptance_criteria: Validation conditions match intended use; covers full operating envelope
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.factor_type: Relevance of the validation activities to the COU
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.rationale: Validation at unit level (scaled impingement) + literature benchmark. Gap: No full-blade validation; no engine conditions (Re > 35,000); no off-design excursions; no transient cycling. Used for design-point screening, relative ranking supported, but absolute accuracy at engine off-design unverified.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.acceptance_criteria: Input data traceable; known quality; calibration certificates available
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.rationale: Coolant data validated vs NIST. Alloy data from supplier datasheet (Lot CM-4471) without independent test. Geometry from CAD/CMM. Reviewers noted lack of lot-specific measurement as a residual uncertainty.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.acceptance_criteria: Independent technical review of modeling effort; review findings and resolutions documented
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.rationale: Independent analyst (T. Bergström) reviewed setup, BC logic, mesh, GCI calc. Two issues found and corrected (<3 K diff). Program-level design review in January 2025 incorporated all action items (TBL-AI-024 to TBL-AI-031).

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.acceptance_criteria: Configuration management; change control; requirements traceability
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.rationale: CAD Rev F matches investment cast. Independent review corrected stale material table. Design review action items closed. Version control implied by specific release (Fluent 2023 R2) and file references (TBL-REG-2023R2).

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.acceptance_criteria: Uncertainty quantification on model outputs; probabilistic methods preferred but OAT acceptable if justified
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.rationale: OAT sensitivity sweep performed (6 params). Combined RSS uncertainty on peak temp ±34 K (95% confidence). Dominant driver: external HTC. Limitation: OAT may underestimate interaction effects; no Monte Carlo performed.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.acceptance_criteria: Results insensitive to reasonable perturbations; parametric sweeps show stability
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.rationale: Sensitivity study shows HTC is dominant driver. Mesh convergence study shows stability in asymptotic range. Literature benchmark confirms robustness of turbulence model for ribbed channels.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.acceptance_criteria: Model used successfully before; flight heritage; prior validation campaigns
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_004.rationale: No specific prior use history for this exact CHT package configuration. Solver (Fluent) has release verification history but no prior use of this specific turbine blade cooling configuration.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_005.acceptance_criteria: Commercial solver certification + independent technical review
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_005.rationale: ANSYS Fluent is commercial certified. Evidence includes regression testing and verification reports, but lacks documented ISO quality processes or version control records.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_005.acceptance_criteria: Code solution matches analytical solution within tolerance (e.g., < 1%)
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_005.rationale: MMS test on 2D fin geometry achieved RMS error of 0.03 K against analytical solution, confirming correct implementation of governing equations.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_005.acceptance_criteria: GCI < 2% based on grid convergence study
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_005.rationale: GCI (fine) is 0.71%, which is well below the 2% program threshold. Convergence order is 2.14.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_005.acceptance_criteria: Residuals converge to machine precision or specified tolerance
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_005.rationale: Residuals reached 10^-6 to 10^-8; mass imbalance was 0.012%. Converged within specified thresholds.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_005.acceptance_criteria: Independent verification of model setup, boundary conditions, and post-processing
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_005.rationale: Mesh quality checks and boundary condition review exist. However, the independent review identified missing documentation on the internal analyst review process and training qualifications as a gap.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_005.acceptance_criteria: Justification for turbulence model (SST) and physics representation
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_005.rationale: SST k-ω selected based on internal benchmarks showing superior performance compared to k-epsilon on legacy data.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_005.acceptance_criteria: Input data accuracy characterized with uncertainty bounds
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_005.rationale: Geometry derived from CAD. Material properties validated. Boundary conditions drawn from cycle deck. However, the hot-gas-side boundary condition uncertainty (±15%) is an external dependency not fully characterized within this model.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_005.acceptance_criteria: Adequate number of specimens/points representing the geometry
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_005.rationale: 42 thermocouple locations on the LX-5 rig were measured. Statistical characterization performed.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_005.acceptance_criteria: Conditions are controlled and measured to known uncertainty
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_005.rationale: Rig instruments calibrated (Type K, NIST-traceable, ±4 K). Reynolds and Biot numbers matched between rig and simulation at test point.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_005.acceptance_criteria: Model inputs accurately replicate experimental conditions
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_005.rationale: Geometry is scaled (1.8x) but similar. Operating point in simulation (LX-7 design) does not match LX-5 rig point (LX-5 test). Extrapolation requires uncertainty addition.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_005.acceptance_criteria: Quantitative metrics comparing prediction to experiment
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_005.rationale: 38/42 thermocouples within measurement uncertainty. 3 outliers attributed to trip-strip augmentation modeling which is not fully resolved.

dev/bundle_nasa_cht_005.acceptance_criteria: QoI measures safety/performance directly and is measurable
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_005.factor_type: Relevance of the quantities of interest
dev/bundle_nasa_cht_005.rationale: Peak metal temperature directly impacts low-cycle fatigue life. Measured via thermocouples.

dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_001.acceptance_criteria: Independent review and verification of setup, boundary conditions, and mesh quality
dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_001.rationale: The simulation plan was signed off prior to analysis. Mesh generation was independent and reviewed. Boundary conditions were documented with traceability to measurements or standards. Peer review Form SIMQ-07 found no major issues. Source: Report Section 9, Appendix A.4, A.7.

dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_001.acceptance_criteria: Governing equations justified and turbulence model validated for physics
dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_001.rationale: SST k-ω was selected with documented literature precedent (5 studies, <5% error) and flow physics considerations (adverse pressure gradients). Wall functions were justified with actual y+ analysis showing <3% outside target range. Source: Appendix A.3, Report Section 3.

dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_001.acceptance_criteria: Input data characterized and traceable to measurements/standards; uncertainty quantified
dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_001.rationale: Fluid properties are constant and appropriate. Inlet conditions are based on ASHRAE/ISO guidelines and physical measurements. Sensitivity studies were performed on key inputs (turbulence intensity, roughness, clearance), with roughness identified as the most influential. Source: Appendix A.4, Report Section 8.

dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_001.acceptance_criteria: Adequate number of specimens/statistical characterization, representative of production
dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_001.rationale: Testing followed ISO 9906:2012 Grade 1B procedures. 11 operating points were measured across the range. A geometrically similar pump (1.6% diameter difference) was tested and corrected via affinity laws. Source: Report Section 7.1.

dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_001.acceptance_criteria: Well-controlled conditions with calibrated instruments and measured uncertainty
dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_001.rationale: Instruments (flowmeter, transducers, torque meter, speed sensor) were calibrated within 12-month intervals with documented accuracy (<1% FS). Combined measurement uncertainty in head was computed as ±1.5% (95% confidence). Source: Appendix A.5, Report Section 7.3.

dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_001.acceptance_criteria: Model inputs match experimental conditions (boundary conditions, fluid state)
dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_001.rationale: Fluid temperature and properties were matched. Inlet turbulence intensity sensitivity was tested. Geometric scaling (1.6% diameter difference) was accounted for via affinity laws, with residual scaling uncertainty noted. Source: Report Section 7.2, A.8.

dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_001.acceptance_criteria: Quantitative metrics, uncertainty bands, statistical validation
dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_001.rationale: Head agreement at BEP was within 1.2% (within combined uncertainty bands). Efficiency difference was 0.7 pp. Residual comparison metrics (GCI) were used for numerical uncertainty. Source: Report Section 7.2.

dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_001.acceptance_criteria: QoI measures safety/performance concern and is measurable computationally and experimentally

dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_001.rationale: QoIs (Head, Efficiency, Pressure Distribution) directly inform the design decision and are measurable in both simulation and physical testing. Source: Report Section 2.

The only gap is the surface roughness of the prototype vs. test, and the scaling correction introduces minor uncertainty. Source: Report Section 10, A.8.

dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_003.acceptance_criteria: Comparison to analytical solution or benchmark
dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_003.rationale: No evidence found. Team relied entirely on vendor documentation. Reviewer notes: "reliance is entirely on vendor documentation".

dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_003.rationale: GCI calculated at design point (1.3%, acceptable). No GCI study performed for off-design or stall conditions (SIM-VCF-007 claims "mesh sensitivity confirmed" without evidence). Near-stall flow is mesh-sensitive; this is a significant gap.

dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_003.rationale: Convergence solid at design point (residuals decay to target, mass imbalance < 0.01%). Near-stall case (SIM-VCF-007) shows residual plateauing at 8e-4 but report claims convergence. This constitutes a serious unresolved convergence issue undermining results.

dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_003.acceptance_criteria: Independent review and verification of model setup
dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_003.rationale: Independent review of boundary conditions and geometry performed. Mesh quality checks done. However, geometry file discrepancy ("rotor_v4_final_FINAL.stp" vs archived file) noted in near-stall case. Analyst competency documentation missing.

dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_003.acceptance_criteria: Justification of governing equations and turbulence model selection
dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_003.rationale: Equations (RANS, SST, MRF) are standard and justified for compressible/negligible Mach regime (Mach 0.18). No sensitivity study for turbulence model selection. Transition effects acknowledged but unquantified (assumption of fully turbulent at Re ~4.5e5).

dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_003.acceptance_criteria: Input data from testing/geometry with uncertainty characterization
dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_003.rationale: Inputs derived from CAD/CMM (max 0.12mm deviation). Inlet conditions from test (Tu 3%). Density correction applied for atmospheric pressure difference but methodology under-documented. Tip clearance fixed at nominal (0.8mm) without uncertainty propagation.

dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_003.acceptance_criteria: Representative experimental test articles with statistical characterization
dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_003.rationale: Dataset from TU Braunschweig is representative of the design space. Facility uncertainty quoted (§4.2). Sample size adequate for 10 operating points.
Calibrated instruments (hot-wire for Tu, orifice for flow). Rotational speed controlled to ±2rpm. Test at specific altitude with density correction applied in CFD.

dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_003.acceptance_criteria: Matching of boundary conditions between model and experiment
dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_003.rationale: Boundary conditions generally match (inlet pressure, outlet mass flow). Gap exists: Test at 98.2kPa vs CFD 101.325kPa, though density correction was applied. Tip clearance fixed in model vs ±0.15mm tolerance in reality.

dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_003.acceptance_criteria: Quantitative metrics (error < 5% for design, < 10% for off-design)
dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_003.rationale: Design point comparison excellent (1.0% error). 80% FC comparison failed (4.8% error). Stall point prediction failed (6 point error). Overall validation does not meet stated use-case accuracy requirements.

dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_003.acceptance_criteria: QoI measures safety/performance and is measurable

dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_003.rationale: QoIs are pressure rise coefficient and stall inception, which are standard and measurable for turbomachinery ranking.

dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_003.acceptance_criteria: Validation conditions match intended COU envelope
dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_003.factor_type: Relevance of the validation activities to the COU
dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_003.rationale: Validated at 1,450 rpm (design point) only. Intended use includes up to 110% flow coefficient and specific off-design points. Stall margin prediction requires off-design mesh convergence which was not achieved. Validation does not cover the full COU envelope.

dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_004.acceptance_criteria: Regression suite passed; version control exists
dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_004.rationale: Stock OpenFOAM 10 binary used; 14 benchmark cases re-run and passed (CMG-OF10-REGR, CMG/Stage2/Validation_Evidence/); GitLab version control established.
Benchmark comparisons (NASA Rotor 37, Gülich) within 2.1% error; no source code modifications.

dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_004.acceptance_criteria: Mesh convergence study performed; GCI below tolerance
dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_004.rationale: Three mesh levels generated; GCI = 0.7% below 2% threshold; Order of convergence 1.94; Medium mesh selected for balance.
Residuals dropped four decades; continuity/momentum residuals flat for 500 iterations; integral variation < 0.05% over 200 iterations.

dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_004.acceptance_criteria: Independent review of setup; mesh quality checked
dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_004.rationale: Independent check by Marcus Weld performed (7 Mar 2025); boundary conditions verified; Python scripts include input validation checks.

dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_004.acceptance_criteria: Governing equations justify physics; turbulence model rationale documented

Inlet data from customer flowmeter (±0.8%); Outlet zero-gradient at 4D; single roughness sensitivity case; reference pressure datum corrected.
FAT data from OEM on geometrically identical unit (2024); 7 operating points covered (65-115% BEP); ISO 9906 Grade 1 calibration standards used.
Calibrated instruments; controlled environment; sensitivity test confirmed outlet location validity (6D vs 4D).
Flow rate from calibrated flowmeter; boundary condition planes verified by sensitivity; roughness assumed conservative.

dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_004.acceptance_criteria: Quantitative metrics comparing prediction to data
dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_004.rationale: Mean absolute error for head (1.1%) and power (1.7%) within ±2.5% and ±4% requirements; qualitative flow structure match noted.

dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_004.factor_type: Relevance of the quantities of interest
dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_004.rationale: Head and shaft power are direct inputs for customer go/no-go design decisions; measurable computationally and experimentally.

dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_004.acceptance_criteria: Validation covers full intended COU envelope

dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_004.rationale: Validated 70-115% BEP; limitations noted for part-load (<70% BEP), transient phenomena, and fluid changes; extrapolation restricted per assessment.

dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_005.acceptance_criteria: Vendor regression tests passed and established history of use in rotating machinery.
dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_005.rationale: ANSYS Fluent 2023 R1 is commercial software with vendor-verified regression tests and published theory guides. No independent verification by the project team was performed (deferred).
Reliance placed on vendor-supplied verification suite due to schedule constraints. No independent analytical solution comparison performed for this specific problem.

dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_005.acceptance_criteria: Mesh resolution adequate and convergence within uncertainty bounds.
dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_005.rationale: Three mesh levels used with GCI methodology. Fine grid GCI = 1.3%. Asymptotic convergence check passed. Mesh quality metrics within thresholds.
Residuals converged to 10^-5, mass imbalance 10^-6. Solution stabilized to 0.05% variation over final 500 iterations.
Independent technical review performed on setup and results interpretation. Boundary conditions, mesh generation, and physics approximations (MRF, water properties) documented.
SST k-ω model selected based on literature for rotating machinery. Sensitivity study performed. Limitations (no cavitation, no leakage) documented but not fully quantified.
Geometry from CAD/CMM. Inlet turbulence intensity set to 5% (sensitivity study confirms low impact). Shaft seals and disk friction omitted based on correlations.
Single factory acceptance test rig (HTR-02) used. No statistical characterization of multiple specimens provided; reliance on representative single unit.
ISO 9906 Grade 2 tolerances. Calibrated instruments (flowmeter ±0.3%, pressure ±0.15%). Uniform inlet profile assumed instead of actual 90° elbow effect.
Operating points matched flow rates. Head values compared directly. Discrepancies attributed to modeling assumptions (inlet profile, omitted losses) but not fully quantified uncertainty.
Quantitative error analysis (mean 2.8%, max 4.9%). Error within ±5% acceptance criterion. Error trends consistent with known physical omissions.

dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_005.factor_type: Relevance of the quantities of interest
dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_005.rationale: Head prediction is a direct performance metric required for EN 809 compliance and tooling selection. Measurable in both CFD and test rig.

dev/bundle_vv40_cfd_005.factor_type: Relevance of the validation activities to the COU

dev/bundle_vv40_cht_001.acceptance_criteria: Commercial solver certification or equivalent QA evidence.

dev/bundle_vv40_cht_001.acceptance_criteria: Evidence from analytical solutions, method of manufactured solutions, or benchmark problems.

dev/bundle_vv40_cht_001.acceptance_criteria: Mesh refinement study showing convergence with quantified error bounds (GCI).
dev/bundle_vv40_cht_001.rationale: Three mesh levels studied (A.1); GCI calculated as 0.6% for temperature and 1.1% for thermal resistance. Order of convergence p=1.93 confirmed. Asymptotic range check passed.

dev/bundle_vv40_cht_001.acceptance_criteria: Evidence of residual convergence and post-processing stability monitoring.
dev/bundle_vv40_cht_001.rationale: Residuals converged to 1e-9; QoI monitors stabilized within 500 iterations (Section 4.2). No specific iteration count target defined in docs, but convergence observed.

dev/bundle_vv40_cht_001.acceptance_criteria: Independent review, boundary condition verification, mesh quality checks.
dev/bundle_vv40_cht_001.rationale: Peer review findings (A.5) addressed turbulence rationale documentation gaps. Mesh tool (ANSYS Meshing) and software log provided in Appendix A.6. Sensitivity to simplified geometry features confirmed.

dev/bundle_vv40_cht_001.acceptance_criteria: Documentation of governing equations, model selection rationale, and known limitations.
dev/bundle_vv40_cht_001.rationale: Realizable k-ε model selected with enhanced wall treatment. Single-phase assumption validated via Bergles-Rohsenow criterion. Non-uniform heat generation limitation documented with ±3.1°C sensitivity analysis.

dev/bundle_vv40_cht_001.acceptance_criteria: Input data from testing or characterization; uncertainty quantified.
dev/bundle_vv40_cht_001.rationale: Material properties from ASTM E1461, vendor certificates, and ASHRAE standards. Input uncertainty quantified via Monte Carlo analysis (Section 5.2, A.3).

dev/bundle_vv40_cht_001.acceptance_criteria: Production-representative samples with statistical characterization and variability justification.
dev/bundle_vv40_cht_001.rationale: Three production assemblies (CP-001, 002, 003) tested. Unit-to-unit variability assessed with ≤1.1°C spread observed (Section A.2).

dev/bundle_vv40_cht_001.acceptance_criteria: Controlled environment, calibrated instruments, and documented standards compliance.
dev/bundle_vv40_cht_001.rationale: Calibrated PT100 RTD (±0.15°C) and Coriolis meter (±0.5%). Test bench purpose-built. Power controlled by programmable load bank.

dev/bundle_vv40_cht_001.acceptance_criteria: Model inputs matched experimental conditions within measurement uncertainty.
dev/bundle_vv40_cht_001.rationale: Boundary conditions (inlet temp, flow) compared directly to experimental conditions in Table A.2. TIM conductivity sensitivity analyzed.

dev/bundle_vv40_cht_001.acceptance_criteria: Quantitative metrics comparing predictions to experiment; within defined acceptance criteria.
dev/bundle_vv40_cht_001.rationale: T_j,max and R_th,jf compared across 10 points. RMS errors (3.4°C, 0.024°C/W) below MAC thresholds (±8°C, ±0.05°C/W). Total combined uncertainty (±6.1°C) within tolerance.

dev/bundle_vv40_cht_002.acceptance_criteria: Residual targets met and stability criteria verified.

dev/bundle_vv40_cht_002.acceptance_criteria: Independent review of model setup, boundary conditions, and mesh quality.

dev/bundle_vv40_cht_002.acceptance_criteria: Physical justification documented and limitations characterized, including turbulence model sensitivity.

dev/bundle_vv40_cht_002.acceptance_criteria: Input data characterized with uncertainty bounds.

dev/bundle_vv40_cht_002.acceptance_criteria: Quantitative metrics and uncertainty bands used to compare model to experiment.

dev/bundle_vv40_cht_004.acceptance_criteria: Governing equations justification, turbulence model selection rationale, constitutive model validation, known limitations documented.

dev/bundle_vv40_cht_004.acceptance_criteria: Material properties from testing, boundary conditions from measurements, geometry from CAD/CMM, input uncertainty characterization.

dev/bundle_vv40_cht_004.acceptance_criteria: Number of specimens, statistical characterization, production-representative samples, sample size justification.

test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.acceptance_criteria: L4: Spatial/temporal discretization adequate with quantified uncertainty (e.g., GCI < 5% or similar bound).
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.rationale: Three-level mesh refinement was conducted. GCI for pressure rise was 1.8% (acceptable). GCI for peak wall shear stress was 6.3% (fine grid) and 11.4% (medium grid). The medium mesh is used for sweeps, introducing higher uncertainty in hemolysis-relevant outputs. No GCI < 5% was achieved for the primary WSS metric.

test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.acceptance_criteria: L3: Iterative solver convergence adequate with defined residual targets.
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.rationale: Steady-state residuals converged below 1×10⁻⁵. Transient simulations ran to 10 revolutions with mass-flow imbalance < 0.3%. Convergence criteria were met and documented.

test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.acceptance_criteria: L3: Independent review of boundary conditions, mesh quality, and setup correctness.
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.rationale: No formal independent review of the CFD methodology by an external party was scheduled or completed. Inlet turbulence intensity was estimated rather than measured. Upstream cannula geometry was omitted from validation cases.

test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.acceptance_criteria: L3: Governing equations and physical assumptions justified with known limitations documented.
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.rationale: SST k-ω was justified by track record in rotating machinery. Newtonian blood rheology (μ=0.0035 Pa·s) was chosen despite known limitations in low-shear regions (< 100 s⁻¹). No Carreau-Yasuda comparison was run yet.

test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.acceptance_criteria: L4: Input data accurate, well-characterized with uncertainty bounds.
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.rationale: Material properties are fixed. Inlet turbulence intensity is estimated from rig geometry. Blood rheology is assumed Newtonian. Density and viscosity of the analog fluid (1058 vs 1060 kg/m³) were matched but not formally characterized for CFD input uncertainty.

test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.acceptance_criteria: L4: Number of specimens/points adequate with statistical characterization and production-representative samples.
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.rationale: Bench tests used a blood analog fluid (glycerol), not real blood. Test conditions are representative for hydraulic performance but lack flow visualization data. No statistical characterization of the fluid properties beyond viscosity matching.

test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.acceptance_criteria: L3: Well-controlled conditions, calibrated instruments, measurement uncertainty characterized.
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.rationale: Tests used aqueous glycerol at 22°C. Inlet turbulence intensity (5%) was estimated, not measured. Test rig calibration was assumed standard for the industry.

test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.acceptance_criteria: L4: Model inputs match experimental conditions with uncertainty propagation.
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.rationale: Pressure rise inputs match (HQ curve). WSS inputs are not directly matched to experiment because PIV data is unavailable. Inlet velocity profiles were derived from flow rates, not direct measurement. Upstream geometry was modeled differently (10-diameter straight section) than the test setup.

test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.acceptance_criteria: L4: Quantitative metrics (error %, correlation) against experimental data with uncertainty bands.
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.rationale: Pressure rise comparison showed ±4.5% error (Pass). Wall shear stress has no direct experimental comparison; validation relies on indirect HQ agreement which is weaker. No uncertainty bands are provided for WSS predictions.

test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.acceptance_criteria: L3: QoIs measure safety/performance concerns, measurable both computationally and experimentally.
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.factor_type: Relevance of the quantities of interest
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.rationale: Wall shear stress (WSS) is the critical QoI for hemolysis risk. It can be measured computationally and would be measurable via PIV/visualization experimentally.

test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.acceptance_criteria: L4: Validation conditions match intended use (same geometry, physics, operating envelope).
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.factor_type: Relevance of the validation activities to the COU
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.rationale: Validation is limited to hydraulic performance (HQ curves) at 2,400-3,600 RPM. There is no validation data for local flow fields (WSS) which are critical for the FDA hemolysis submission. The operating envelope covers RPM but lacks rheology validation.

test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.acceptance_criteria: L3: Input data sources traceable with ISO 17025 calibration and quality assessments.
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.rationale: No explicit pedigree records are provided for the CFD inputs or test data. The analog fluid properties are stated but lack full traceability chains or certification documents.

test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.acceptance_criteria: L3: Independent technical review with review board findings and resolutions.
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.rationale: An independent review of the CFD methodology by an external party has not been scheduled or completed. The model was developed in-house with internal oversight only.

test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.acceptance_criteria: L3: Systematic development with configuration management and requirements traceability.
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.rationale: IT security handles configuration, but no specific model development process records (Git history, change control) are detailed in the memo. Requirements traceability for the CFD effort is not explicitly documented here.

test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.acceptance_criteria: L4: Uncertainty quantification on outputs via Monte Carlo, probabilistic methods, or confidence intervals.
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.rationale: Only a limited deterministic sensitivity study was performed on 3 parameters. No formal probabilistic UQ (Monte Carlo, Polynomial Chaos) was conducted. Input uncertainty characterization is missing.

test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.acceptance_criteria: L3: Results insensitive to reasonable perturbations.
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.rationale: WSS peak values are notably sensitive to viscosity (±19% change for ±15% change). The model is not robust to the Newtonian assumption in low-shear regions. test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.acceptance_criteria: L3: Evidence of prior successful applications or flight heritage.
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_007.rationale: SST k-ω has a known track record in rotating machinery. However, there is no specific history of the HeartDrive Mk-III model or this specific application to blood pumps.

test/bundle_nasa_cfd_008.acceptance_criteria: Residual convergence to specified tolerance (e.g., RMS < 1e-5) and mass/momentum balance verification
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_008.rationale: Design point converged to 8e-6. Off-design Case 2 residuals plateaued at 3e-5 (criterion not met) but accepted based on analyst judgment of mass balance. Case 3 residuals never converged. Reviewer flagged lack of independent verification of Case 2 convergence acceptance.

test/bundle_nasa_cfd_008.acceptance_criteria: Independent review of setup, boundary condition verification, and mesh quality checks
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_008.rationale: Wall y+ verified at 12 locations (mostly < 5). Inlet profile from upstream CFD; outlet static pressure specified. Geometry simplifications (fillets, bleed ports) noted but sensitivity not quantified. Internal inconsistency regarding frame change method (mixing-plane vs frozen-rotor) flagged as unresolved.

test/bundle_nasa_cfd_008.acceptance_criteria: Justification of turbulence model selection and constitutive assumptions against known limitations
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_008.rationale: SST k-ω chosen for adverse pressure gradients. Transition modeling omitted (fully turbulent). Reviewer acknowledged SST limitation at tip regions but noted curvature correction attempt. No validation against RANS-experiment for rotating frames provided.

test/bundle_nasa_cfd_008.acceptance_criteria: Input data traceable to measurements; material/boundary conditions verified against CAD or test data
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_008.rationale: Inlet total pressure from upstream IGV model (Rev 3), which did not include revised trailing-edge geometry. Inlet uniform total pressure assumed, contradicting documented presence of 4% distortion. Geometry simplifications not quantified.

test/bundle_nasa_cfd_008.acceptance_criteria: Adequacy of experimental data; production-representative samples; sufficient number of measurement points
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_008.rationale: NASA Rotor 37 dataset used has sufficient points for the primary QoIs. Company Archive Case AC-217 used for surrogate validation but had different turbulence model, weakening direct applicability.

test/bundle_nasa_cfd_008.acceptance_criteria: Well-controlled environment; calibrated instruments; measurement uncertainty characterized
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_008.rationale: NASA Rotor 37 data represents standard experimental conditions. AC-217 had 15% difference in Reynolds number and different turb model. Internal inconsistencies regarding inlet distortion conditions (uniform vs. 4% amplitude) noted.

test/bundle_nasa_cfd_008.acceptance_criteria: Model inputs match experimental conditions; boundary condition fidelity
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_008.rationale: Discrepancies in inlet distortion treatment (Slide 3 vs. Technical Note). Missing solver settings for 3 cases. CAD revision linkage to CFX files unconfirmed.

test/bundle_nasa_cfd_008.acceptance_criteria: Quantitative metrics (error %, correlation) comparing model to experiment; uncertainty bands
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_008.rationale: Comparison to NASA Rotor 37 shows pressure ratio error < 1.2%, but efficiency overprediction (1.4%) is noted as a model limitation. Project-specific validation absent pre-test. Abstract claims validation across operating range, but data only covers design point and one near-design condition (overstated).

test/bundle_nasa_cfd_008.acceptance_criteria: QoIs measure safety/performance; measurable computationally and experimentally
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_008.factor_type: Relevance of the quantities of interest
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_008.rationale: Primary QoIs (pressure ratio, efficiency) are standard aerodynamic performance metrics. Secondary QoIs (pressure profile, leakage loss) are traceable to physical measurements.

test/bundle_nasa_cfd_008.acceptance_criteria: Validation conditions match intended use (same operating conditions, physics regime)
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_008.factor_type: Relevance of the validation activities to the COU
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_008.rationale: Design point is interpolated (moderate confidence). Stall margin prediction at 82% mass flow is extrapolation (low confidence). Inlet distortion unvalidated. Validation data (NASA Rotor 37) is rotor-only, while model includes stator interaction (extrapolation).

test/bundle_nasa_cfd_008.acceptance_criteria: Input data sources traceable; ISO 17025 calibration certificates; data provenance records
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_008.rationale: NASA Rotor 37 data has known pedigree. AC-217 data source and specific turbulence model history not fully characterized in report. Inlet profile source is an upstream CFD model whose revision state was not re-validated for this run.

test/bundle_nasa_cfd_008.acceptance_criteria: Independent technical review of modeling and simulation effort; peer review records
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_008.rationale: External reviewer (Dr. Holmberg) provided written comments. GCI calculations and validation plots independently re-generated. However, off-design convergence assessment was NOT independently reviewed. Turbulence model selection had only informal discussion, no formal sign-off.

test/bundle_nasa_cfd_008.acceptance_criteria: Systematic development; configuration management (Git); change control; requirements traceability
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_008.rationale: Files version-controlled in GitLab (tag v3.2.1). V&V plan exists but written post-hoc (after runs). 3 cases missing solver settings files. No formal link between CAD revision and CFX project file confirmed.

test/bundle_nasa_cfd_008.acceptance_criteria: Uncertainty quantification on model outputs; Monte Carlo, sensitivity analysis, confidence intervals
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_008.rationale: Combined uncertainty estimate on efficiency is ±0.7% but described as "informal RSS" not traceable to documented methodology. No formal UQ methods (Monte Carlo, polynomial chaos) performed. Sensitivity study incomplete (only 1 out of 3 turbulence models tested).

test/bundle_nasa_cfd_008.acceptance_criteria: Results insensitive to reasonable perturbations; parametric sweeps
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_008.rationale: Parametric sweep performed on tip clearance and inlet turbulence. Efficiency sensitivity to inlet turbulence deemed negligible. Model sensitive to inlet distortion (unclear impact due to BC inconsistency). Robustness to turbulence model choice demonstrated at design point only (SST vs k-ε), not stall approach.

test/bundle_nasa_cfd_008.acceptance_criteria: Evidence model or similar models used successfully before; flight heritage; previous validation campaigns
test/bundle_nasa_cfd_008.rationale: ANSYS CFX has established verification history. Company had previous experience with similar stages (Case AC-217) but geometry scaling (0.87 ratio) and Reynolds number differences exist. No specific flight heritage for this stage configuration.

test/bundle_nasa_cht_006.acceptance_criteria: Commercial solver certification and regression testing with configuration control
test/bundle_nasa_cht_006.rationale: ANSYS Fluent 2023 R2 is maintained under SQMS-2024-001; input files archived in PDM (Windchill); version locked; peer check of input deck performed.

test/bundle_nasa_cht_006.acceptance_criteria: Comparison to analytical solutions or benchmark problems with error thresholds met

test/bundle_nasa_cht_006.acceptance_criteria: Residuals converged to target and monitor variation < 0.5%

test/bundle_nasa_cht_006.acceptance_criteria: Independent verification of model setup, boundary conditions, and mesh quality
test/bundle_nasa_cht_006.rationale: Peer check record (PeerCheck-CHT-2024-047-02) reviewed input decks; independent V&V review (IRR-CHT-2024-047) confirmed boundary condition consistency.

test/bundle_nasa_cht_006.acceptance_criteria: Justification of governing equations and turbulence model selection with known limitations

test/bundle_nasa_cht_006.acceptance_criteria: Adequate number of specimens and measurement points with statistical characterization

test/bundle_nasa_cht_006.acceptance_criteria: Calibrated instruments, controlled environment, and adherence to test standards

test/bundle_nasa_cht_006.acceptance_criteria: Model inputs match experimental conditions accounting for measurement uncertainty propagation

test/bundle_nasa_cht_006.rationale: RMSE of 7.3% across 14 stations; Nu prediction within experimental uncertainty band at nominal Re=42,000; pressure drop error 3.2%.

test/bundle_nasa_cht_006.acceptance_criteria: QoI directly measures safety/performance concern and is measurable both computationally and experimentally

test/bundle_nasa_cht_006.acceptance_criteria: Input data sources are traceable to ISO 17025 calibration certificates or quality assessments
test/bundle_nasa_cht_006.rationale: Material data cross-referenced with MTR-IN718-2022-04; instrument calibration documented in RTR-CHT-2023-08.

test/bundle_nasa_cht_006.acceptance_criteria: Evidence of independent technical review of the modeling and simulation effort

test/bundle_nasa_cht_007.rationale: Fluent license/IT infrastructure manages build control; no formal CAE QA documentation available per memo.

test/bundle_nasa_cht_007.acceptance_criteria: Model inputs match experimental conditions within uncertainty bounds
test/bundle_nasa_cht_007.rationale: Geometric mapping used non-dimensional arc-length; inlet plenum differences noted; boundary conditions derived from separate CFD model.

test/bundle_nasa_cht_007.acceptance_criteria: Independent technical review of modeling effort
test/bundle_nasa_cht_007.rationale: UDF reviewed informally by two team members; no formal independent review or peer review board records.

test/bundle_nasa_cht_007.acceptance_criteria: Prior successful applications or flight heritage
test/bundle_nasa_cht_007.rationale: No prior flight heritage or specific use history for TBCS-3 model cited; general Fluent history assumed.

test/bundle_nasa_cht_008.acceptance_criteria: Code must have undergone formal verification and post-processing must have peer review with resolved issues.

Script verification score is adequate (3) but the open issues create a gap for Level 4/5 certification of the specific Rev C mesh configuration.

test/bundle_nasa_cht_008.acceptance_criteria: Independent verification against analytical solutions or benchmark problems must be performed and pass.
test/bundle_nasa_cht_008.rationale: STAR-CCM+ vendor test suite was referenced but not run independently for this geometry. In-house scripts had unit tests covering only 11 of 17 functions. Method of Manufactured Solutions (MMS) was explicitly noted as out of scope. Reliance on vendor suite without independent execution constitutes a gap for Level 3.

test/bundle_nasa_cht_008.acceptance_criteria: Grid Convergence Index (GCI) must be < 5% across three refinement levels with mesh independence confirmed.

test/bundle_nasa_cht_008.acceptance_criteria: Residual convergence targets met and solution stability verified over multiple iterations.

test/bundle_nasa_cht_008.acceptance_criteria: Independent review of model setup, boundary conditions, and mesh quality completed with no unaddressed discrepancies.
test/bundle_nasa_cht_008.rationale: Simulation plan reviewed by Dr. A. Vasquez (independent peer). Identified turbulence model documentation vs. XML inconsistency (Slide 3). Radiation boundary condition discrepancy identified (Slide 8). Peer review flagged issues but some (turbulence model text vs XML) were noted as "will correct" but NOT YET CORRECTED as of review date, constituting a gap for Level 4/5.

test/bundle_nasa_cht_008.acceptance_criteria: Governing equations and turbulence models justified; known limitations documented.

Transition model limitations at leading edge acknowledged. Model form is adequate (3) but the contradiction in documentation reduces confidence in the "form" as written in the plan.

test/bundle_nasa_cht_008.acceptance_criteria: Material properties from testing or validated sources; boundary conditions from measurements.
test/bundle_nasa_cht_008.rationale: Mainstream BCs from companion RANS calculation. Coolant from measurement (±3 K). TBC properties from open literature (Padture et al., 2002); program-specific vendor data outstanding. Geometry from CAD (explicitly meshed). Input characterization is adequate (3) but TBC uncertainty is high due to lack of proprietary data.

test/bundle_nasa_cht_008.acceptance_criteria: Experimental test articles represent production conditions; statistical characterization performed.
test/bundle_nasa_cht_008.rationale: AFRL Turbine Aero Rig, Lot 7 used. Matched Biot number and Reynolds number. Not full-temperature (rig T_in = 450 K, engine T_in = 1847 K). 12 thermocouples at mid-chord; IR data on suction side only (pressure side obstructed). Sample set is adequate for the scope of mid-chord validation but does not cover full span or full temperature range.

test/bundle_nasa_cht_008.acceptance_criteria: Test conditions match Intended Use (COU); measurement uncertainty characterized.
test/bundle_nasa_cht_008.rationale: Rig mainstream temperature (450 K) does not match engine (1847 K). Radiation effects present in engine (5-15% load) but NOT present in rig and NOT modeled in simulation. Cooling chemistry (dry air vs fuel-rich) not matched. Conditions represent a significant gap from the COU envelope.

test/bundle_nasa_cht_008.acceptance_criteria: Model inputs match experimental conditions including boundary conditions and geometry fidelity.
test/bundle_nasa_cht_008.rationale: Geometric fidelity is high (explicit TBC, 17/23 holes modeled). Boundary conditions match for inlet flow and mainstream profile. However, outer casing BCs are adiabatic in simulation vs. insulated shroud (verified but not measured for this config). Leading-edge BCs (transition) mismatch between model and rig conditions leads to 17-21% Nu underprediction.

test/bundle_nasa_cht_008.acceptance_criteria: Quantitative metrics (error %, correlation) comparing model to experiment; uncertainty bands defined.
test/bundle_nasa_cht_008.rationale: MAE of 3.8 K (0.9%) for internal temps; Max error 9.2 K flagged. Nu match within ±12% on suction side. Leading edge Nu error is 17-21%. Error is acceptable for mid-chord and optimization (trend matching) but not for life prediction at LE. Metrics are present.

test/bundle_nasa_cht_008.acceptance_criteria: QoI directly measures safety/performance; measurable both computationally and experimentally.
test/bundle_nasa_cht_008.factor_type: Relevance of the quantities of interest
test/bundle_nasa_cht_008.rationale: QoI (peak metal temp, Nu distribution) is directly relevant to life prediction and cooling design. Quantifiable by thermocouples (TC) and IR (Nu). However, peak temp magnitude is affected by unmodeled radiation, affecting the QoI's fidelity for life prediction.
